title: LEC: Count on Us
description: A cinematic LEC Winter promo built around trust, ambition and the return of competition.
overview: Count on Us captures the focus and competitive energy that come with the start of a new LEC season. Created as a Winter promotional film, it builds toward the return of the league and the rivalries waiting to unfold.

Neon-lit environments, close-up character moments and rapid transitions create a sense of forward motion. Green light and warm flashes of orange tie the sequence together, leading into the League of Legends EMEA Championship reveal.
